WITH yearly_category_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.pcf_violation_category,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(collision_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as db_year,
        COUNT(*) as collision_count
    FROM collisions c
    WHERE c.pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.pcf_violation_category, CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(collision_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER)
),
total_by_year AS (
    SELECT 
        db_year,
        SUM(collision_count) as total_collisions
    FROM yearly_category_counts
    GROUP BY db_year
),
category_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        ycc.pcf_violation_category,
        ycc.db_year,
        ycc.collision_count,
        COALESCE(tby.total_collisions, 0) as total_collisions,
        1.0 * ycc.collision_count / COALESCE(tby.total_collisions, 1) as share
    FROM yearly_category_counts ycc
    LEFT JOIN total_by_year tby ON ycc.db_year = tby.db_year
)
SELECT 
    db_year,
    pcf_violation_category,
    collision_count,
    total_collisions,
    share
FROM category_shares
WHERE db_year IN (2011, 2021)
ORDER BY db_year, collision_count DESC

    SELECT 
        c.pcf_violation_category,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(collision_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as db_year,
        COUNT(*) as collision_count
    FROM collisions c
    WHERE c.pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.pcf_violation_category, CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(collision_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER)
),
total_by_year AS (
    SELECT 
        db_year,
        SUM(collision_count) as total_collisions
    FROM yearly_category_counts
    GROUP BY db_year
),
category_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        ycc.pcf_violation_category,
        ycc.db_year,
        ycc.collision_count,
        COALESCE(tby.total_collisions, 0) as total_collisions,
        1.0 * ycc.collision_count / COALESCE(tby.total_collisions, 1) as share
    FROM yearly_category_counts ycc
    LEFT JOIN total_by_year tby ON ycc.db_year = tby.db_year
),
most_common_2021 AS (
    SELECT pcf_violation_category
    FROM (
        SELECT pcf_violation_category, collision_count,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pcf_violation_category ORDER BY collision_count DESC) as rn
        FROM category_shares
        WHERE db_year = 2021
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    mpc.pcf_violation_category as most_common_2021_category,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cs.db_year = 2011 THEN cs.share END) as share_2011,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cs.db_year = 2021 THEN cs.share END) as share_2021,
    ((MAX(CASE WHEN cs.db_year = 2021 THEN cs.share END) - MAX(CASE WHEN cs.db_year = 2011 THEN cs.share END)) * 100) as percentage_point_decrease
FROM most_common_2021 mpc
JOIN category_shares cs ON mpc.pcf_violation_category = cs.pcf_violation_category
